'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Blake Huffman LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)|V25-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' 78 Card Deck
* '''Username:''' Anodos
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
